To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) teacher candidates in South Africa and in the USA were transformed through peace-focused instruction in their teacher preparation courses, 2) their transformation was evidenced by their changed attitudes and behaviors in the classroom and by their increased commitment to social justice, and 3) the transformation process was sustained by the instructor’s commitment to peace education.
